name: Marcus
description: An adult Black man in his late thirties with deep brown skin, a broad square face, dark brown eyes, close-cropped black hair, and a neatly trimmed short beard. He wears an olive canvas overshirt over a dark crewneck T-shirt and has a confident, easygoing expression.
voice_description: Full, resonant masculine voice with a neutral American accent, clear articulation, and an assured conversational pace.
